sentences.text: Every vessel shall proceed at a safe speed adapted to the prevailing circumstances and conditions of restricted visibility.
A power-driven vessel shall have her engines ready for immediate maneuver.
Every vessel shall have due regard to the prevailing circumstances and conditions of restricted visibility when complying with Rules four through ten.
In practice, that means slowing down, posting an extra lookout to listen, sounding the fog signals of Rule thirty-five, keeping your navigation lights on, and plotting every radar target.
